Start date: 1348-01-08  
Subtract 28 weeks = 28 × 7 = 196 days.  
Plus 6 days = 202 days total subtraction.  

1348 is a leap year (divisible by 4, pre-Gregorian but using Gregorian rules as instructed).  
Jan 8 minus 202 days:  
Go back 8 days to 1347-12-31, then 194 more days.  
December has 31 days → back to Dec 1 is 30 days earlier (31 Dec to 1 Dec = 30 days back).  
Remaining 194 − 30 = 164 days before Dec 1.  
Count back through months:  
Nov 30 days → 134  
Oct 31 days → 103  
Sep 30 days → 73  
Aug 31 days → 42  
Jul 31 days → 11  
Jun 30 days → −19 (overshoot) so date is in June.  
June 30 − 11 = June 19.  

FINAL_ANSWER: 1347-06-19
